Moodle Doctor

Inspect health, cron, plugins, environment and pasted errors without giving AI permission to execute commands or change the site.

Supported scope
Health, cron, plugins, environment and error context
Design focus
Facts first, interpretation second
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Six diagnostic workflows
Run health checks, error explanation, cron diagnosis, plugin diagnosis, environment diagnosis and investigation checklists.
✓
Exact preview before AI
Show the sanitized message array to the administrator and require explicit confirmation before it is sent.
✓
Read-only by design
There is no endpoint for shell commands, SQL execution, cache purges, configuration writes, task execution or automatic fixes.
Sensitive fields omitted
Task output/customdata, database credentials, sessions, cookies and provider credentials are deliberately excluded from collected facts.
Recursive sanitizer
Redact common passwords, tokens, authorization headers, cookies, DSNs and embedded URL credentials.
One-time previews
Bind preview nonces to the current user/session and expire them after a short window.
What this plugin does

Moodle Doctor is an administrator troubleshooting aid, not an autonomous repair agent. PHP gathers verifiable diagnostic facts, and AI can help organize hypotheses, evidence and next checks only after those facts are sanitized and previewed.

The AI contract requires uncertainty to remain visible: hypotheses cannot be presented as collected facts and a root cause should not be declared without supporting evidence.

Features you get
Health check
Summarize Moodle/PHP/database versions, environment checks, Check API state, cron and plugin dependencies.
Cron diagnosis
Inspect cron freshness, delayed scheduled tasks, adhoc tasks and recent failures.
Plugin diagnosis
Compare installed/disk versions, requirements, dependencies, status and task metadata.
Error explanation
Sanitize administrator-pasted stack traces before any AI request.
Environment diagnosis
Combine Moodle environment checks with status, security and performance checks.
Investigation checklist
Turn a bounded system context into a structured list of safe diagnostic next steps.

Also requires AI Bridge.
